posts.title: Introducing Mail Hermit
posts.description: Mail Hermit is an open-source local-only email message transfer program. If you want to change your email address from one provider to another (ie: gmail or yahoo to a more private email server – like Modoboa) and take your email messages with you, then Mail Hermit was made especially for you.
